KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. kitoto

2. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano.

3. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

4. When practising Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha Simulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)

5. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. nene
   C. pana
   D. fupi

13. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma 7 .2.1 Ufupisho and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
